selection_rule: All generated test profiles are retained. Test profiles use a split-specific random stream and are not used for training, checkpoint selection, or tuning.
limitations: These are controlled application-goodput profiles, not measured radio traces or packet-level network simulations.
The test distribution shares scenario families with training but uses independent parameter draws; it measures transfer across rates and transition timing, not unseen transition families.
The two content ladders share the same seven nominal bitrate choices; their segment sizes and durations differ.
